fields.description: Most recently entered 3-character player initials (name-entry working buffer); copied to save offset 0x2BE0 on store and restored on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b9c copies 4 bytes from _DAT_08001c60 to SRAM save offset 0x2BE0 via func_0x0803d0f4; FUN_08001aa8 loads 4 bytes from the same SRAM offset back via func_0x0803d090. Value in baseline.sav is 'SWD\0', matching the 3-char + NUL initials format written by FUN_080004dc (3-byte copy via func_0x080457a8).
fields.name: last_entered_initials

fields.description: Course 0x00 top-1 entry initials (first of 3 sorted entries in the 24-byte course record).
fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc(course = param_1, record = param_1 * 0x18 + table base) stores a 3-byte name at record + 0x00 via func_0x080457a8; table base maps to save offset 0x2BE4 (FUN_08001b9c writes 0x360 bytes there, FUN_08001aa8 reads them back). Baseline: 'NOR'.
fields.name: course_00_first_initials

fields.description: Course 0x00 top-1 entry score (u32 LE at record + 0x04). Baseline: 300, matching FUN_08000584 default FUN_080004dc(0, 300, ...).
fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc keeps the 3-entry table sorted by comparing param_2 against u32 slots at record + 0x04/+0x0C/+0x14 and stores the winner; FUN_08001b9c persists the 0x360-byte table at save offset 0x2BE4.
fields.name: course_00_first_score

fields.description: Course 0x04 top-1 entry initials. Baseline: 'DAL' (player-beaten default).
fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc record layout (name at record + 0x00 via 3-byte func_0x080457a8 copy); save offset 0x2BE4 + 0x04 * 0x18 = 0x2C44. FUN_08000584 seeds course 0x04 via FUN_080004dc(4, ...).
fields.name: course_04_first_initials

fields.description: Course 0x04 top-1 entry score (u32 LE at record + 0x04). Baseline: 529 (beats the 422 default second entry, proving live sorted-insert).
fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc sorted-insert into u32 slot at record + 0x04; sample 529 > default 0x1a6 (422) seeded by FUN_08000584 FUN_080004dc(4, 0x1a6, ...). Persisted by FUN_08001b9c at save offset 0x2C48.
fields.name: course_04_first_score

fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc record = idx * 0x18; save offset 0x2BE4 + 0x1A * 0x18 = 0x2E54, name at record + 0x00. FUN_08000584 seeds course 0x1A with FUN_080004dc(0x1a, 300, ...)/(0x1a, 0x96, ...)/(0x1a, 0x46, ...) matching sample scores 300/150/70.
fields.name: course_1a_first_initials

fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc u32 slot at record + 0x04; save offset 0x2E58. Default 300 via FUN_08000584 FUN_080004dc(0x1a, 300, ...); persisted by FUN_08001b9c.
fields.name: course_1a_first_score

fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc second-entry name slot at record + 0x08 (3-byte func_0x080457a8 copy); save offset 0x2E5C. Default 0x96 (150) via FUN_08000584 FUN_080004dc(0x1a, 0x96, ...).
fields.name: course_1a_second_initials

fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc u32 slot at record + 0x0C; save offset 0x2E60. Persisted by FUN_08001b9c, verified by FUN_08001aa8 checksum.
fields.name: course_1a_second_score

fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc third-entry name slot at record + 0x10 (3-byte func_0x080457a8 copy); save offset 0x2E64. Default 0x46 (70) via FUN_08000584 FUN_080004dc(0x1a, 0x46, ...).
fields.name: course_1a_third_initials

fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc u32 slot at record + 0x14; save offset 0x2E68. Persisted by FUN_08001b9c, verified by FUN_08001aa8 checksum.
fields.name: course_1a_third_score

fields.description: Course 0x21 top-1 entry initials (short-scale scoring course). Baseline: 'LOA'.
fields.evidence: FUN_080004dc record = idx * 0x18; save offset 0x2BE4 + 0x21 * 0x18 = 0x2EFC, name at record + 0x00. FUN_08000584 seeds course 0x21 with FUN_080004dc(0x21, 0x7d, ...)/(0x21, 100, ...)/(0x21, 0x37, ...) matching sample scores 125/100/55.

fields.name: course_21_first_score

magic_signatures.description: SRAM header magic u32 0x48FED829 at offset 0; FUN_08001aa8 compares *(u32*)save_base to this constant before accepting the save (falls back to FUN_08000584 defaults on mismatch).
